issues.title: Selection rerender clears active drag or pan

prechangeEvidence.nodeDrag: After node a was selected, a requested move from (400, 31.2) to (520, 131.2) left it at (400, 31.2).
prechangeEvidence.selectedStatePan: After prior selection was cleared, a requested (+60,+30) pan left translation at (0,0).

issues.rootCause: The selection-dependent visualization effect reconstructed mutable runtime state with drag:null and pan:null.

postchangeEvidence.contract: Compatible graph/layout/view effect recreation preserves pan and preserves drag only while its vertex still exists.
postchangeEvidence.termination: Mouseup, mouseleave, touchend, graph replacement, layout replacement, view replacement, and unmount clear incompatible interaction state.
